limitations.text: Confounded reading (outside review 2026-11-23 00:10): E34 (E9's 5-block layout widened to d=576, about the same unique params and FLOPs as E32) scores 0.2834 clean80, 14% WORSE than E32 (0.2486). So 'unique params at matched FLOPs' is not sufficient; at matched params and FLOPs, depth (more distinct blocks) beat width here. E32-E34 ran at their file LRs (6e-3), not LR-tuned per shape, and n=1, so depth vs width vs LR fit is unresolved. SQ282 (LR-fair depth/width discriminator) and SQ283 (seed replication) test it.
